chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
"Whoever gives the adhan in one of the cities of the Muslims for a year, Paradise becomes obligatory for him."

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan, meaning he called people to salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslims, meaning the Muslim community

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving the adhan for a year in a Muslim city?
ai.summary: This hadith states the great reward for one who consistently gives the adhan among the Muslims for a full year. It emphasizes the virtue of serving the religious life of the community through calling people to salat (prayer), with the promised reward of Paradise.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.881 - The Messenger, and his family, said:
"Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) in one of the cities of the Muslims for a year, Paradise becomes obligatory for him."
